dict.string: Sauron records your microphone so it can capture your side of the meeting and transcribe it on this Mac.
Sauron transcribes meetings on-device using Apple Speech. Audio is not sent to Apple or Sauron servers.
Sauron uses your calendar to show what’s up next and to match live meetings to scheduled events. Choose which calendars to subscribe to in Settings. Calendar access is optional.

Sauron captures meeting audio (including FaceTime call audio) so it can transcribe other participants locally on this Mac.
Sauron captures the meeting window and system audio. Nothing is uploaded; recordings stay on this Mac.
